answer_1.quote: We introduce Video-ChatGPT, a novel multimodal model ... capable of understanding and conversing about videos.
answer_1.outputs: Generated video‑aware textual responses such as answers to questions, descriptions, summaries, and conversational dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We develop an evaluation pipeline using the GPT‑3.5 model. This pipeline assesses various capabilities of the model and assigns a relative score to the generated predictions on a scale of 1‑5.
automatic_metrics: GPT‑3.5 scoring (1‑5 scale across correctness, detail orientation, contextual understanding, temporal understanding, consistency)

answer_3.quote: We develop an evaluation pipeline using the GPT‑3.5 model... This pipeline assesses various capabilities of the model and assigns a relative score... We also evaluate with the open‑source LLM Vicuna‑1.5 (13B) as an alternative judge.
methods: LLM‑based scoring pipeline using GPT‑3.5 prompts
